title: Garrett Wilson: I feel great, but still some work to do to be back to myself

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Garrett Wilson: I feel great, but still some work to do to be back to myself
sources.description: The Jets took three players in the first round of this year's draft, which led to hope that David Bailey, Kenyon Sadiq and Omar Cooper can spark a long-awaited return to the playoffs for the AFC East team.
